subject: Re: Follow-up: IAM evidence & SOC 2 questions (Acme Health)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: IAM evidence & SOC 2 questions (Acme Health)

Hi Claire —

Great to meet with you and Tom today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps on the security/compliance items you flagged:

1) SOC 2 status: Redwood currently maintains a SOC 2 Type II report (rolling 12-month coverage). I can share the redacted summary and control mapping; our SOC 2 report is available under NDA.

2) IAM / SSO: You asked about SSO and provisioning. We support SAML 2.0 SSO and SCIM for automated user provisioning (both outbound and inbound depending on setup). RBAC is enforced via team and role constructs; admins can create scoped admin roles.

3) Evidence collection: To help your security team, I attached a short IAM evidence checklist and our SOC 2 summary doc. If your security team prefers a vendor security questionnaire (VSQ), please send it over and we’ll fill it out.

Proposed next steps:
- Claire / Tom: send your vendor questionnaire or confirm the specific controls you need evidence for.
- Redwood: Lauren and I will coordinate with Aditya (security) and Dev (solutions engineering) to gather artifacts and configuration docs.
- Schedule: Aim to deliver initial evidence within 3 business days after receiving the questionnaire.

If useful, we can schedule a quick technical session (30 minutes) for Dev to walk through SSO/SCIM implementation.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: iam-questionnaire-acme.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@acmehealth.com>

Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@acmehealth.com>, security@acmehealth.com
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: IAM evidence & SOC 2 questions (Acme Health)

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the recap.

I attached our standard vendor security questionnaire (VSQ) and highlighted the IAM-related controls we’re most concerned about (SSO, SCIM provisioning, admin role separation, logging of admin actions). We’re also required to confirm HIPAA scoping for any PHI processing — please confirm whether Redwood processes any PHI in hosted deployments or whether customers are expected to de-identify before sending.

Can you also confirm whether your SCIM implementation supports group sync (i.e., pushing group membership and group-based roles) or only user provisioning?

We’d like to kick off the evidence review this week — if you can provide the SOC 2 summary and the IAM evidence checklist filled in, that’d be a great start.

Thanks,

Claire Nguyen
Security Operations Manager, Acme Health
Claire.Nguyen@acmehealth.com

Attachment: Acme_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: IAM evidence & SOC 2 questions (Acme Health)

Looping in details on our IAM evidence and answers to Claire’s questions — pulling the artifacts now. Quick notes:

- SOC 2: We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report under NDA; I’ll attach the control mapping for IAM-related controls (CC6, CC7 equivalents) and the SOC 2 summary.

- SCIM: Our SCIM implementation supports user provisioning + group sync and group membership attributes. You can map groups to RBAC roles (team -> role mapping). We support PATCH and bulk provisioning.

- SSO/SAML: We support SAML 2.0 with IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows, attribute mapping for email, name, and role claims. We also support on-prem IdPs via metadata upload and can provide step-by-step SSO guide.

- Admin controls / RBAC: Admins are scoped to org, team, and route-level permissions. All admin actions are logged (audit trail with user, timestamp, action, and request id). Logs can be exported to your SIEM (S3/CloudWatch/Datadog).

Action items (internal):
- Dev: prepare the SSO/SCIM setup guide and screenshots showing group->role mapping.
- Marissa / Lauren: share the VSQ with legal/security review and coordinate NDA for SOC 2 delivery.
- Aditya: prepare the IAM control mapping spreadsheet.

I’ll start compiling the attachments; ETA EOD tomorrow.

— Aditya
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood-iam-control-mapping.xlsx (will be attached in follow-up)

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: SSO/SCIM setup guide and sample mappings (Acme Health)

Hi Claire —

Thanks for the questionnaire. I’ve attached a concise SSO + SCIM setup guide and a sample group->role mapping workbook that shows how to push groups via SCIM and map them to Redwood roles. Highlights:

- SCIM features: full user lifecycle (create/replace/patch/deactivate), bulk import, and group membership sync. We push group.displayName and group.members attributes and accept membership lists for mapping.
- SAML attributes: email, givenName, familyName, roles (optional). We recommend using email as the unique identifier for matches.
- HIPAA / PHI: Redwood does not process PHI on behalf of customers by default in our hosted offering; customers choose to send de-identified content or deploy in a Private/VPC configuration with additional contractual protections. We’ll need legal to confirm specifics for written attestation.

I attached: sso-scim-setup-guide.pdf and sample-group-role-mapping.csv. Let me know if you want a 30-minute runbook call this week for a demo.

Thanks,

Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai

Attachments: sso-scim-setup-guide.pdf (application/pdf); sample-group-role-mapping.csv (text/csv)

Subject: Re: Follow-up: IAM evidence & SOC 2 questions (Acme Health)

Claire —

Appreciate the quick turnaround from everyone. Next steps on our side:
- Aditya will send the redacted SOC 2 summary and the IAM control mapping under NDA by EOD today. I’ll coordinate the NDA execution with your legal team.
- Dev has shared the SSO/SCIM guide — if that looks good, let’s schedule the 30-minute technical runbook.
- I’ve started filling the VSQ and will share the first pass by COB today; Aditya will review technical answers.

Propose a 30-minute sync with your security team tomorrow (Thu) at 10:00 AM PT to walk through SSO/SCIM and answer the VSQ clarifications. Does that time work?

Thanks again — we’ll keep this moving.

Marissa
